metadata.subject: Fictional frontier photonic interconnect scaling claim

ambiguous_criteria: A demonstration is announced but measurement conditions are not inspectable.
failure_criteria: The window closes without a qualifying demonstration.
predictions.statement: A qualifying public demonstration reaches milestone M by the end of the observation window.
success_criteria: A public demonstration reports milestone M with inspectable measurement conditions.
At least one independent source can reproduce or validate the measurement.
unresolved_criteria: The program ceases public reporting before resolution.

reasoning_patterns.rationale: One summary is derivative of root A and is not counted as independent corroboration.

signal.statement: Two independently rooted public reports indicate a fictional photonic interconnect architecture may reach a defined scaling milestone within twelve months.

tests.decision_rule: Prefer the hypothesis whose pre-registered predictions best match the measured outcomes; preserve unresolved status if evidence is unavailable.
discriminating_evidence: Pre-registered milestone measurements across repeated integration runs.
tests.observable_outcome: Measured milestone attainment and failure-mode distribution by the end of the window.
tests.question: Which scaling hypothesis better predicts measured integration performance?
